name: time-field
title: Time field
description: Hour, minute and AM/PM segments you step with arrow keys or type into.
a11y: A named group of spin buttons (Hour, Minute, AM or PM), each with aria-valuenow, aria-valuemin, aria-valuemax and aria-valuetext.
ArrowUp/ArrowDown step a segment (minutes by the step prop), PageUp/PageDown step further, Home/End jump to the limits, Backspace clears.
Typing digits fills a segment and moves to the next; A and P set AM and PM.
ArrowLeft/ArrowRight move between segments and are mirrored in right-to-left.
